capability: Give known gaps their own colour instead of hiding them
title: Let the unfinished joins glow.

hook.picture: Close on the whale at a board where every card shows a teal tick. A pod walks the line and falls through a join that was never built.
hook.words: Every box on our board said green.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The status said all green. The plan still had holes.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: project sponsor at a status meeting

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three pods fall through, every 2 beats, then 1, then a half.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Unfinished bits get painted green too.

stakes.body: Teams plan on top of work that does not exist yet, and the surprise lands late and expensive.

solution_hint: Give known gaps their own colour.

metaphor.body: Built joins stay teal. Joins the plan names as not built yet glow terracotta with a flag, so pods stop at them instead of falling through. The whole map honestly reads 'not finished'.

steps.picture: The whale walks the joins. Built joins stay teal. Joins the plan names as not built turn terracotta with a small flag.
steps.words: Known gaps get their own colour.
steps.sound: The horn note on each terracotta join.

steps.picture: A pod reaches a terracotta join, sees it, stops, and routes around it.
steps.words: Now anyone can see where to stop.
steps.sound: A horn note, then a turning figure.

steps.picture: Push-in. The teal joins along one stretch fuse into a single steady line, and the fusing stops at each terracotta flag.
steps.sound: A sustained chord that pauses at each flag.

steps.picture: The board's overall chip changes from all green to a calm 'not finished' tone.
steps.words: Not glued yet. And that's the truth.

real_case.claim: The OAH review marks six first-class facts in terracotta (named unbuilt, unresolved or accepted limits, one 'deferred by decision'); Φ is false because those six are named disagreements, not errors.

honest_limit.picture: A join that looks teal but is hollow inside, with no flag because nobody wrote it down. A pod falls through it.
honest_limit.words: Only gaps someone wrote down can glow.

not_this.body: Named gaps only. Unknown holes stay hidden.

ending_pattern.body: The same status board, now honest: known gaps glow terracotta, the pods stop and route around them, and none falls.
ending_pattern.callback: The pod that fell through the green hole in bar 2 stops at the glowing gap instead, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Show the gaps you know about. Name them.
